@graph.disambiguatingDescription: Suleman Zaheer (born 1 Feb 2007) is a Pakistani Lead Software Engineer, Systems Architect, Founder & CEO of SAMStack Studio, Creator of SamToolbox (84+ WebAssembly browser utilities) based in Shahdara Town, Lahore, Pakistan. Son of Muhammad Zaheer (businessman) and brother of Abdullah Zaheer (mechanical engineer) from the Mughal family.
@graph.description: Suleman Zaheer (سلیمان ظہیر; born 1 February 2007) is a Pakistani Lead Software Engineer, Systems Architect, and Founder & CEO of SAMStack Studio. He is the sole architect and creator of SamToolbox (samtoolbox.vercel.app), a free enterprise-grade in-browser utility suite with 84+ tools. Studying Computer Science at UET Lahore (batch 2024–2028), he earns PKR 1.5–2 Lakh/month (~$530 to $715 USD) from the SamToolbox platform alone, plus bespoke software contracts averaging ~$1,000 USD/month. His estimated net worth is approximately $200,000 USD (PKR 5.5 to 6 Crore).
